sources.source_name: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
sources.acquisition_contract: download official monthly/complete CSV snapshot; record release month and SHA256
sources.parser_contract: strict CSV schema; preserve transaction id, date, price, postcode, PAON/SAON/street/locality/town/district/county and property type
sources.normalization_contract: uppercase trimmed postcode and deterministic address tokenization; no fuzzy overwrite
sources.spatial_binding_contract: bind through verified address/UPRN/title bridge; nearest-point assignment forbidden
sources.promotion_rule: market factor only after verified parcel/address binding and provenance readback

sources.acquisition_contract: coordinate/UPRN query for samples; bulk CSV/GeoJSON/Parquet for portfolio scale; record query or snapshot URL
sources.parser_contract: strict entity fields including entity, reference, dataset, organisation, start/end dates, point and geometry
sources.normalization_contract: WGS84 EPSG:4326; retain current/all period selection and dataset coverage metadata
sources.spatial_binding_contract: exact geometry intersects/within relation against verified parcel polygon; point-only promotion forbidden
rejection_conditions: API absence treated as no constraint
sources.promotion_rule: only dataset-specific verified spatial relation with coverage caveat

sources.acquisition_contract: official bulk GeoJSON/Parquet or bounded API extraction; record collector/snapshot date
sources.parser_contract: entity, reference, organisation, current period, hectares, dwellings, permission status, point and geometry
sources.normalization_contract: retain authoritative/current flags and truthful null dwelling fields
sources.spatial_binding_contract: current site polygon to exact parcel polygon relation; candidate point inside parcel gate retained
sources.promotion_rule: growth candidate only after exact site and parcel polygons plus verified relation

sources.acquisition_contract: official bulk geometry snapshot with provider and collection dates
sources.normalization_contract: deduplicate only by explicit stable entity/reference rules; preserve provider conflicts
sources.spatial_binding_contract: parcel polygon intersection; boundary-touch reported separately
sources.promotion_rule: constraint flag only after parcel polygon relation and quality note

sources.acquisition_contract: official dataset snapshot; retain Historic England identifiers and update date
sources.normalization_contract: grade normalized without changing official identifier; point representation retained
sources.spatial_binding_contract: verified building outline or curtilage relation required; dataset point alone is screen only
sources.promotion_rule: penalty only after outline/curtilage evidence intersects exact parcel

sources.acquisition_contract: official annual polygon snapshot; record return year and publication date
sources.normalization_contract: retain snapshot vintage and later-change caveat
sources.spatial_binding_contract: exact parcel polygon intersection and overlap area
sources.promotion_rule: policy factor only with snapshot date and exact polygon overlap

sources.acquisition_contract: official CSV/Excel release; record release date, correction date and selected variant
sources.parser_contract: geography code/name, year, age/sex aggregation and projection value
sources.normalization_contract: explicit local-authority code version and selected migration variant; no parcel interpolation
sources.spatial_binding_contract: local-authority membership proxy only, joined by official geography code
sources.promotion_rule: area-level demand factor only with explicit variant/vintage

sources.acquisition_contract: official corrected CSV/Excel supporting file; record selected variant and correction lineage
sources.parser_contract: geography code, year, age, sex, inflow/outflow/net migration
sources.normalization_contract: retain sign convention, variant, 25-year horizon and geography version
sources.promotion_rule: area-level migration factor only after correction-aware readback

sources.acquisition_contract: official daily CSV/XML/API snapshot; record publication timestamp
sources.parser_contract: ATCOCode/NaptanCode, stop type, status, common name, longitude/latitude, locality
sources.normalization_contract: WGS84 coordinates; active status and stop-type taxonomy retained
sources.spatial_binding_contract: distance from exact parcel polygon/centroid with service evidence joined separately
rejection_conditions: stop proximity used as service frequency
sources.promotion_rule: access factor only after active stop and current route/service binding

sources.acquisition_contract: credentialed official API or cached official timetable/location download
sources.parser_contract: TransXChange timetable, SIRI-VM location and UK NeTEx fares as separate feeds
sources.normalization_contract: operator/service/line/stop identifiers and validity dates; time zone explicit
sources.spatial_binding_contract: join service stops to verified NaPTAN identifiers then parcel access distance
sources.promotion_rule: service-frequency factor only after credentialed feed, validity and NaPTAN join

sources.acquisition_contract: Rail Data Marketplace credentialed JSON API/push feed snapshot
sources.parser_contract: station CRS, scheduled/estimated times, cancellation and service identifiers
sources.normalization_contract: GB rail time zone, operating date and station code mapping
sources.spatial_binding_contract: station coordinate/CRS binding plus parcel-to-station distance
rejection_conditions: realtime-only sample treated as typical frequency
sources.promotion_rule: rail service factor only after station and representative service-window evidence

sources.acquisition_contract: official WebCAT export/import path or approved grid/site lookup snapshot
sources.parser_contract: PTAL/TIM value, grid/site identifier, scenario and assessment date
sources.normalization_contract: current/future scenario explicit; boundary-cell provenance retained
sources.spatial_binding_contract: site/grid cell containing verified parcel point/polygon; no hand-entered nearest cell
sources.promotion_rule: PTAL/TIM factor only after official site/grid relation and scenario date

sources.parser_contract: URN, establishment name/type/status, phase, postcode, coordinates and open/close dates
sources.normalization_contract: active status and latest record per URN; official coordinates only
sources.promotion_rule: amenity proximity only after active status and verified coordinate

sources.acquisition_contract: official ORD API snapshot with rate below 5 requests/second and since-date sync
sources.normalization_contract: active organisation and role taxonomy; postcode normalized
sources.spatial_binding_contract: geocode verified official address/postcode through approved bridge; no guessed coordinate
sources.promotion_rule: health amenity factor only after active role and verified address location

sources.acquisition_contract: official six-monthly GeoPackage/Shapefile/GML snapshot under valid licence
sources.parser_contract: site id/name/function/access point and polygon geometry
sources.normalization_contract: source CRS transformed with recorded pipeline; function taxonomy retained
sources.promotion_rule: greenspace factor only after polygon relation and release provenance

sources.source_name: EA Flood Zones plus Climate Change
sources.acquisition_contract: official Environment Agency spatial snapshot with dataset version date
sources.parser_contract: flood zone/scenario attributes and polygon geometry
sources.normalization_contract: scenario, probability band, climate-change allowance and CRS explicit
sources.spatial_binding_contract: exact parcel polygon intersection and overlap proportion
sources.promotion_rule: risk penalty only after versioned exact polygon overlay
